prompts.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing, compositing of the supplied real photographs.
Create ONE finished vertical Instagram Story launch poster, portrait 9:16, ideally 1080x1920. This is card 1 in a coherent personal creator website launch campaign, not a generic tech startup advertisement.
Inputs: Image 1 is the REAL KAIF LIFE website mobile screenshot, supporting insert and design reference. Image 2 is the REAL author's photograph sitting with his laptop in a café, photographic compositing input. Keep the real photograph and person's face, body, clothes and laptop faithful. Do not invent a new face or repaint him.
Art direction: sophisticated playful adventure diary, editorial magazine typography, warm ivory paper #f5f1e8, near-black #24251f, vivid orange #ec4e20, tiny yellow sticky-note accent. Mix bold grotesk headlines with a small elegant italic serif annotation. Real photo in one large slightly tilted white paper photo frame; smaller real website screenshot as a crisp overlapping print on the lower right, visually clearly a screenshot, not a recreated or invented website. Restrained paper texture, generous margins, pleasing crisp design, readable on a phone. Flat vector eight-spoke orange asterisk as brand mark, NO emoji.
Use only the following exact Russian text, no other copy:
small top brand: "KAIF LIFE"
large headline in upper section, two lines: "У KAIF LIFE" / "теперь есть сайт."
small supporting line: "Собрал место для своих историй."
small lower label: "01 / Запуск"
large clear URL near bottom: "kaif-life.com"
Keep all important text inside 8% horizontal margins, top 10% and bottom 13% safe zones. No logos from platforms, no fake engagement numbers, no fake awards, no watermark, no fake clickable UI, no browser chrome. Preserve all supplied photo subjects; typography must be exact, Cyrillic legible. This is a complete standalone story card, not a grid or contact sheet.

Use case: ads-marketing, compositing. Create ONE finished 9:16 portrait Instagram Story card, ideally 1080x1920. This is slide 2 of a KAIF LIFE website launch.
Input roles: Image 1 is the approved launch poster STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its warm ivory paper, orange black typography, taped white photo frames and playful editorial look. Image 2 is the REAL travel photograph of the author at Zakynthos, exact photographic content. Image 3 is a REAL frame of the author and his friend in a convertible, exact photographic content. Preserve the photographs and identities faithfully; do not regenerate people or change faces, expressions, clothing or cars.
Composition: bold typographic headline in upper third, then two beautifully staggered wide photo prints: the travel shot cropped as a print while preserving the seated author and turquoise bay, and below it the convertible frame with both friends visible. Orange thin hand-drawn connecting marks, one small pale-yellow tape strip, a crisp eight-spoke vector asterisk. Minimal honest personal creator announcement. No emoji, no fake products, no fake interface, no invented statistics.
Palette exactly warm ivory #f5f1e8, near-black #24251f, orange #ec4e20, small yellow #f1d760.
Text VERBATIM in Russian, exact spelling, no extra invented text:
brand "KAIF LIFE"
headline, 2 lines: "Не всё" / "попадает в видео."
supporting line "Путешествия. Тачки. За кадром."
short note "Пять историй уже внутри."
small page label "02 / Что внутри"
URL "kaif-life.com"
Make all text large and crisp for mobile. VERY IMPORTANT story safe area: keep all meaningful content between y=190 and y=1640 on a 1920-high canvas, use the bottom 15% as unprinted ivory paper. The URL must be around 78% of canvas height, not at the bottom edge. Generous 8% side margins. Standalone single card, not a collage of multiple story slides.

Use case: ads-marketing / compositing.
Create ONE premium, spacious 9:16 vertical Instagram Story invitation card for KAIF LIFE. Match the approved reference's warm ivory paper #f5f1e8, black #24251f, orange #ec4e20, bold sans + beautiful italic serif, white photographic print and orange eight-spoke line asterisk. It is slide 3, and should be visibly calmer and airier than slide 1.
Input 1: approved card, STYLE ONLY. Input 2: real photograph of the author at a turquoise Zakynthos bay, use it faithfully as a photo print. Preserve original identity, expression, clothes and actual scenery. No invented person, no retouched or newly generated face.
CRITICAL COMPOSITION: This card needs empty margins for Instagram controls. In a 1080x1920 canvas, leave y=0..160 EMPTY ivory and y=1630..1920 EMPTY ivory. Keep every piece of text and every photo inside x=85..995 and y=180..1550. This must NOT reuse the giant URL against the bottom edge from the style reference. Bottom quarter must be sparse.
Small brand at y~200: "KAIF LIFE"
Very large headline near y~300: "Есть что" / "вспомнить." with second line orange italic.
One medium-sized portrait photo print centered, from y~560 to y~1130, slightly tilted, showing the author and recognizable bay.
Text below the photo, two clean readable lines: "Красивые кадры." / "И как было на самом деле."
CTA small but readable: "Заходи в гости"
URL clearly visible at y~1400: "kaif-life.com"
Label: "03 / Увидимся на сайте"
Leave an empty ivory region around y~1530 to place a native Instagram link sticker later; DO NOT draw a fake sticker, fake button or placeholder instructions.
Only the exact specified Russian copy. No emoji, no watermark, no extra claims, no added phone, no social logos. A standalone story card.

Use case: ads-marketing / compositing.
Create ONE finished wide landscape 16:9 Telegram post cover for a personal creator's website launch, ideally 1600x900. NOT a vertical story and NOT a contact sheet.
Inputs: Image 1 is the approved campaign STYLE reference (warm ivory paper, orange / black large typography, tape and tilted photo prints). Image 2 is a real screenshot of the website: use as an accurate insert, do not invent or rewrite the website interface. Image 3 is a real photo of the author in Zakynthos: preserve the photograph and face faithfully, no generated replacement person.
Art direction: welcoming personal launch, the diary of an adventurous software developer who also makes YouTube videos. Warm paper #f5f1e8, near-black #24251f, vivid orange #ec4e20, small yellow tape, tasteful orange eight-spoke line asterisk, restrained hand-drawn orange underline. Bold modern sans with elegant italic serif. Strong readable hierarchy at Telegram feed size. No emoji, no fake stats, no watermark, no new product, no fake browser or phone UI.
Composition: left half is generously spaced headline and URL; right half a handsome tilted photo of the author, with a smaller crisp print of the actual website screenshot overlapping the lower area. Keep all text within 7% edge margins. The URL must be very clear.
Exact text only:
small brand "KAIF LIFE"
headline "Теперь и на сайте."
italic tagline "Есть что вспомнить."
large URL "kaif-life.com"
No other new captions. Preserve spelling and lettering. One standalone horizontal finished cover.
